keyDecisions: Photo native uid is its actual active_document generation; its persistent native Document.id remains a separate exact uint64 field. No invented vector identity or mask object array.

Native raster selection remains a typed reference to actual full coverage stored in the native source; bounds/preview are not substituted for alpha. Native revision and actual UI mask/channel/tool/brush revision fence execution.
Use actual background job completion from the displayed App; accepting a command is not completion.
Hosted reopen preserves profiles and source bytes; unsupported bounded import formats remain unavailable instead of passing through unbounded defaults.
Only supported actual formats/tools are shown; Photo and Deck remain incomplete until their own gates pass.
risks: WASM memory: native upstream defaults allow much larger sparse canvases and decoded data than the DSH host budget.
Native file menus, async imports, live strokes/type and background jobs must not bypass source ownership or acknowledge unsaved data.
Photo pcraft export byte determinism/source-pair matching must be proved; persist the actual paired source bytes when necessary.
Do not expose missing mask/service/PSD semantics as completed features.
